name: architecture-design
description: Architecture design skills for building polished, production-grade applications.

interface.shortDescription: Architecture guidance for native-feel cross-platform desktop apps.
interface.longDescription: Architecture Design packages skills for designing polished application architectures. The initial skill focuses on cross-platform desktop apps that must feel native across macOS and Windows, including native shells, system WebViews, typed IPC, memory tradeoffs, and ship-readiness audits.
defaultPrompt: Use Architecture Design to evaluate my desktop app architecture.
Run the native-feel decision tree for this cross-platform app.
Audit this desktop app for native-feel readiness.
